# zutable

The goal of zutable is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of zutable from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zutable")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(zutable)
## basic example code
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`na()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/na.md) : A typed
  missing value
- [`register_extension_type()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/register_extension_type.md)
  : Register an R vector class as an extension type
- [`schema()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  [`field()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  [`not_null()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/schema.md)
  : Fields and schemas
- [`zutable_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zutable/reference/zutable_info.md)
  : Information about the zutable build
